senate.description: Residential housing construction materials sales and use tax exemption authorization

additions: (a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction of new residential housing are exempt.

(b) The tax on purchases exempt under paragraph (a) must be imposed and collected as if the rate under section 297A.62, subdivision 1, applied and then refunded in the manner provided in section 297A.75.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2025.
(18) building materials, equipment, and supplies for the construction of new residential housing exempt under section 297A.71, subdivision 55.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2025.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2025.
